note: What a server sends to restate how many of a lasting effect are stacked on a unit. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which slot. A client fails where it is above 31.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many are stacked there now.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long it has left to run, in seconds. With runningFor it adds up to the whole run the effect was added with.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How long it has already run, in seconds.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that put it there. Where the client holds no such unit, it leaves the effect with no caster.
